name: marketing-ideas
title_zh: 170+ 招营销打法，按你的生意现配现用
tagline_zh: 别再从零憋创意。把你的生意背景喂进去，它从 170+ 真实打法库里挑出能落地的几招，还告诉你为什么是这几招。
tagline_en: Stop brainstorming from scratch. Feed it your business context, get 170+ proven plays filtered down to the few.
desc_en: Produces the best marketing ideas for your business by analyzing your FOUNDER_CONTEXT and matching it against a curated database of 170+ proven marketing strategies. Use when user needs creative, actionable marketing ideas tailored to their business.
why_zh: 不是生成天马行空的点子，而是拿你的 FOUNDER_CONTEXT 去匹配一个已验证的策略库——每个建…
why_en: It doesn't invent from thin air—it matches your context against a curated library of proven plays, so every idea comes with.
limit_zh: 只出营销思路，不写落地文案、不排投放计划。需要你先有清晰的 FOUNDER_CONTEXT（行业、产品、阶段）。
limit_en: Ideas only—no copywriting or media plans. Requires a filled FOUNDER_CONTEXT (industry, product, stage) or matches get generic. Biased to early-stage.
title_en: 170+ proven marketing plays, matched to your business
